candidates.term: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate
candidates.defline: Brilliance stands at your Month Gate: the working world sees the performer, dazzling and hard to manage.
candidates.reading: This position rules Career and Social, and it runs the prime of your life. The Virtuoso stands at your Month Gate in view: the working world sees your talent before your discipline, and both are real. Your prime wants a stage, formats loose enough for brilliance and honest enough to score it. Bosses who need obedience will not keep you, and the feeling is mutual. Reputation through your thirties and forties runs on performance, visible wins, quotable work. Pick collaborators who enjoy fireworks. Then finish things. Finished brilliance is the only kind the era rewards.
candidates.teaser: The working world sees your talent before your discipline, and both are real. Careers with a stage suit you, and bosses who need obedience will not keep you.

domain_readings.Career: The working world sees your talent before your discipline, and hires the first while praying for the second: both are real, and stages suit you better than desks. Choose careers with performance in them, pitching, teaching, creating, leading from the front. Supervision is your kryptonite and spotlight your spinach.
domain_readings.Social: Your professional circle divides on contact: champions and detractors, rarely neutrals. The champions carry you further than consensus ever would. Collect them deliberately, thank them loudly, and let the detractors keep each other company. Polarizing is a strategy when the poles are chosen.

candidates.life_chapter: Your rising chapter performs: the prime decades run on visible wins, quotable work, and the occasional bridge burned with flair. Expect reputation to be your currency and finish to be your challenge. The era pays completed brilliance triple. Ship the encore, not just the opening night.
candidates.relations: Champions and rivals are this seat’s people: the bosses who bet on you, the ones who tried to leash you, all of them stories now. Your professional loyalty is fierce and conditional on respect. State the condition upfront. It saves everyone a season.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the stage stays dark: talent rehearsing privately for no announced show. Book the venue. Any venue. The gift needs witnesses to grow.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, every gathering becomes a stage: colleagues as audience, meetings as reviews. Do one thing anonymously this month.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, the performance never ends: applause required for breakfast.
candidates.health_line: You metabolize attention like sugar: highs, crashes, cravings. Balance the performance diet with unwitnessed work, and the nerves steady.
